scripts.clean: node -e "const fs=require('node:fs');for (const path of ['dist','lib','coverage','mikromeet-release']) fs.rmSync(path,{recursive:true,force:true});for (const entry of fs.readdirSync('.')) if (entry.endsWith('.zip')) fs.rmSync(entry,{force:true})"
scripts.deploy: npm run deploy:frontend && npm run deploy:backend
scripts.dev: npm run build:dev && concurrently "npm run dev:client" "npm run dev:server"
scripts.docs: npm run docs:install && npm --prefix docs run dev
scripts.docs:build: npm run docs:install && npm --prefix docs run build
scripts.docs:preview: npm run docs:install && npm --prefix docs run preview
scripts.format: biome format --write src tests static scripts build.mjs vitest.config.ts package.json tsconfig.json biome.json mikromeet.config.example.json
scripts.licenses: mkdir -p security && grant check security/sbom.spdx.json --config .grant.yaml > security/grant-report.txt || { cat security/grant-report.txt; exit 1; }
scripts.lint: biome check src tests static scripts build.mjs vitest.config.ts package.json tsconfig.json biome.json mikromeet.config.example.json
scripts.lint:fix: biome check src tests static scripts build.mjs vitest.config.ts package.json tsconfig.json biome.json mikromeet.config.example.json --write
scripts.release: npm run build && npm run sbom && npm run scan && npm run licenses && npm run release:assets
scripts.scan: mkdir -p security && grype sbom:security/sbom.spdx.json -o json > security/grype-report.json
scripts.verify: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run build && npm run docs:build
scripts.precommit: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test
